title: Linear Algebra
subtitle: Vector spaces and linear maps
summary: Vector spaces, matrices, eigenvalues, inner products, SVD, and the spectral theorem.
detail:
Studies vector spaces and linear maps between them. A vector space over a field \(F\) is a set with addition and scalar multiplication satisfying axioms. Linear maps preserve these operations; their matrix representations depend on the choice of basis.

The eigenvalue problem \(Av=\lambda v\) is central: the spectral theorem says symmetric matrices have orthonormal eigenbases with real eigenvalues. SVD decomposes any matrix as \(A=U\Sigma V^T\), revealing its geometric action. Applications: least squares, PCA, Fourier analysis (DFT as a change of basis), quantum mechanics (observables as Hermitian operators).
